items.title: Use tantra369.com for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point tantra369.com at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Turn on visitor statistics
items.detail: Your old site counted visitors. Turn on OpenSpace's privacy-friendly statistics in one click.

items.title: Check special features
items.detail: Your old site had add-ons (chat, booking or other widgets). See which ones you still need.
